chunks: Though within sight of one another. The sinner would like to ransom himself from the torment of that Day by offering his sons,

key_terms.يُبَصَّرُونَهُمْ: They will be made visible to one another

ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about a sinner's desire to ransom himself on the Day of Judgment?
ai.summary: In Surah Al-Ma'arij, this verse depicts the moment of ultimate realization where sinners are made visible to one another, intensifying their mutual regret. The desire to ransom oneself with one's own children underscores the depth of their anguish and the high value placed on deliverance from Hell, even at the cost of their closest kin. This imagery serves as a powerful reminder of the individual accountability and the irreversible nature of divine justice on the Day of Resurrection.
